name: Visionary
intro: The Visionary pathway controls the mind, emotions and dreams, eventually shaping reality through imagination and psychological authority.

meter.name: Insight
meter.gain: Reading enemy intent and applying mental control

ability.name: Flaw Analysis
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Flaw Analysis — +10 percentage points critical chance; +15 percentage points critical damage. Passive.

ability.name: Predictive Parry
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Predictive Parry — Reduces incoming all damage by 10% after shields; +15 percentage points Dodge. Passive.

ability.name: Psychic Frenzy
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Psychic Frenzy — Deals 120% INT Psychic damage (25% base DEF bypass); Enemy ATK −20% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Battle Hypnosis
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Battle Hypnosis — Deals 100% INT Physical damage (25% base DEF bypass); Apply resistible hypnosis for 1 turn. At 100 charge, command the victim's next action against its own side.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Dream Tether
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Dream Tether — Deals 20% INT Death damage (25% base DEF bypass); +20% INT for 1 turn; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Psychological Invisibility
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Psychological Invisibility — 100% chance: avoids targeting and incoming damage for 1 turn; Stores +30% damage for your next landed damaging-skill hit; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Dream Prison
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Dream Prison — Deals 130% INT Psychic damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Absolute Discernment
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Absolute Discernment — +20% DEF; Immune to Confused; Immune to Illusion; Immune to Taunt. Passive.

ability.name: Author's Script
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Author's Script — Deals 250% INT Psychic damage (25% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Stunned (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 90 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Envisioning Cataclysm
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Envisioning Cataclysm — Targets all enemies; Deals 380% INT True Psychic damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
